title: Q-Pain clinical vignettes: treatment decision
description: Vignettes built to test race/gender bias in pain management. Decision: prescribe / treat. ACA Section 1557. Add disability, veteran, sexuality clauses. Verify PhysioNet licence allows publishing derived outputs.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Q-Pain vignettes score a treatment decision

Scenario: Race and gender clauses shift the prescribe/treat decision
  Given the Q-Pain clinical vignette pool with race/gender clauses inserted and a decision of prescribe or treat, and the PhysioNet licence confirmed to allow publishing derived outputs
  When I run bd score on the q-pain task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/q-pain reports the signed shift vs the floor with a 95% interval and flags any cell where PhysioNet terms would block publication

right_now_summary: Q-Pain vignettes are being scored for race and gender effects on prescribe-or-treat decisions.
